role: pre-state-space empirical signal diagnostic; not final confirmatory model

observation_harmonization.image_offset: Within each species, for every site-species-season containing both direct and image-based records, compute median(log1p(image)) - median(log1p(direct)); the species offset is the median of those mixed-season differences.
observation_harmonization.adjustment: Subtract the species image offset from image-based log counts. Direct and unknown-vantage records receive no mean adjustment.
observation_harmonization.season_aggregation: Median adjusted log count within site-species-season.
observation_harmonization.accuracy_role: Not used to weight the empirical point diagnostic; the final state-space model retains the already-frozen accuracy 1 versus pooled 2-5 observation-scale structure.

coupling_estimator.detrending: Within each unit, OLS adjusted_log_count ~ intercept + centered breeding season; retain slope as secondary mean-trend diagnostic and use residuals for coupling.
coupling_estimator.forcing_group: Use exactly the Gate 2C modeling-eligibility geography for that species and unit.
coupling_estimator.forcing: For each focal unit-season, median detrended residual among other units in the same forcing group observed that season.
coupling_estimator.standardization: Within each focal unit's matched seasons, z-standardize the leave-one-out forcing.
coupling_estimator.lambda: OLS slope from focal residual ~ intercept + forcing_z.

crossover_readout.low_area: d lambda / d H at A=-1 SD = beta_H - beta_AH
crossover_readout.high_area: d lambda / d H at A=+1 SD = beta_H + beta_AH
crossover_readout.predicted_pattern: beta_AH < 0, low-area H effect >= 0, high-area H effect < 0

uncertainty.permutation_test: 5000 permutations of lambda within forcing group, deterministic seed 20260929
uncertainty.directional_p: fraction of permuted beta_AH <= observed beta_AH, with +1 correction

secondary_diagnostics: Regress each unit's secular log-count trend slope on the same A + H + R + A:H + forcing-group design to distinguish response filtering from ordinary mean-trend association.
Report empirical lambda support counts and forcing-group composition by species.
Direct-only re-estimation is sensitivity-only if at least 20 trait-complete lambda estimates remain within a species.

outcome_blind_support_note.basis: Computed from season-presence metadata only, before count magnitudes were opened.

terminal_rules: Do not change the minimum of 6 matched seasons after inspecting counts.
Do not replace the leave-one-out forcing with a pooled forcing containing the focal unit.
Do not add or remove site traits, interactions, radii, years, or forcing groups based on diagnostic results.
A null or opposite-signed beta_AH remains a valid falsification of the crossover hypothesis.
Do not describe this empirical diagnostic as the final state-space inference.
